people.name: Brook_of_Egypt
people.line: Southwestern boundary of the Promised Land

people.name: Great_Sea
people.line: The Mediterranean Sea, the western boundary of the Promised Land.

people.name: Meribah
people.line: A place where Moses disobeyed God

people.name: Tamar
people.line: Landmark on the southeastern border of Israel

translations.web: “The south side southward shall be from Tamar as far as the waters of Meriboth Kadesh, to the brook, to the great sea. This is the south side southward.
translations.bsb: On the south side it will run from Tamar to the waters of Meribath-kadesh, and along the Brook of Egypt to the Great Sea. This will be the southern boundary.
translations.kjv: And the south side southward, from Tamar even to the waters of strife in Kadesh, the river to the great sea. And this is the south side southward.
translations.asv: And the south side southward shall be from Tamar as far as the waters of Meriboth-kadesh, to the brook of Egypt, unto the great sea. This is the south side southward.
